testcase.name: Scenario: Choose and restore annotation scale for an active view: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/model-browser-published-snapshot/checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1038:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Choose and restore annotation scale for an active view ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and activates BrowserView ✔ And an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active ✔ And its annotation scale is Auto ✔ When the user opens the active view's context menu and expands Annotation Scale ✔ Then Auto is checked ✔ And fixed ratios and Custom are available ✔ When the user chooses 1:1 ✔ And the user reopens the Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then 1:1 is checked ✔ And Auto is not checked ✔ When the user chooses Auto ✔ And the user reopens the Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then Auto is checked ✔ And 1:1 is not checked ✔ When the user dismisses the menus ✔ Then the copied view remains active ✔ And the viewport remains empty
